Source: gpui-component 0.9.0 from the Cargo registry.
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE-APACHE. Original sources and locale files retained.
Selected by the root Cargo.toml [patch.crates-io] entry.

Local changes:
- src/diff/parser.rs: display non-UTF-8 bytes in Git-quoted paths as escapes
  so their patches can be viewed. File operations use the application's raw path.
- src/diff/mod.rs: increase the scaled code font by one logical pixel.
- src/diff/mod.rs: keep ordinary split diffs at equal viewport widths in
  horizontal-scroll mode. One shared scrollbar moves code within clipped panes;
  headings and the center divider stay stationary. Unified and single-column
  review surfaces retain their original scrolling behavior.
- src/diff/selection.rs: use clipped text bounds when resolving the clicked side,
  so overflowing text from the opposite pane cannot capture a selection.
- src/tab/tab.rs and src/tab/tab_bar.rs: honor explicit pixel heights and
  theme.shadow for segmented controls. Use the tab_active theme token for both
  the stationary selection and its animated indicator, keeping their appearance
  consistent in the compact 28 px workbench controls.

Regression coverage: src/app/diff_tests.rs in the application. Run:
cargo test --features ui-tests app::diff_tests

The application now always enables soft wrap and exposes no horizontal-scroll
setting. The library's generic non-wrapped mode remains available internally;
application regressions verify equal panes, wrapping, selection and no horizontal
movement at narrow and wide viewport sizes.

When upgrading GPUI Kit, compare these patched files with the upstream version and
remove this override only after the layout, scrolling and selection tests pass.
